newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks rebound, Hoiupank leads.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks rebound, Hoiupank leads.

text.p: Estonian shares rebounded on Wednesday after a brief bout of profit-taking, dealers said.
Total trade on the main list was 48.1 million kroons and the Talsi index rose 1.89 percent to close at 352.07.
The market has grabbed the Baltic bourse limelight in recent weeks as a spate of promising interim results and revised profit forecasts propelled it to new highs.
Hoiupank gained the most during the day to close at 213.75 kroons, up 5.75 kroons after turning over 15.1 million kroons.
Dealers said Hoiupank's strong showing propped up Hansapank .
"Hoiupank is still strong and investors don't think that Hansapank can stand still or fall with Hoiupank holding buyers' interest," one dealer said.
"Hoiupank could still go a little higher," one trader said.
Hansapank followed Hoiupank with 15.1 million kroons traded to be 4.75 kroons higher to close at 195.75 kroons.
"It seems that Hansapank is trying to find a new level as it stayed between 190-195 kroons during the day," one trader said.
"I don't see Hansapank going above 195 kroons or falling below 190," he added.
On the free market, 23.3 million kroons changed hands with Norma, an automotive safety belt manufacturer, the most active stock.
Norma lost 1.33 kroons to close at 87.17 kroons after trade of 11.8 million kroons.
